steps.title: Three Steps to Unlock Your Entitlements
steps.subtitle: No agents, no guesswork. Simple, deterministic matching based on verified government orders.
steps.step1_desc: Share your basic demographic, education, and occupation details voluntarily. We never ask for Aadhaar, bank credentials, or OTPs.
steps.step2_desc: Our dynamic engine evaluates official gazettes and eligibility rules against your profile to find schemes you qualify for.
steps.step3_desc: Understand benefits, required documents, and step-by-step application instructions with official direct portal links.

how_it_works.title: How NammaSeve Matches Welfare Without Guesswork
how_it_works.subtitle: A personal-profile-first matching engine designed around citizen transparency, deterministic logic, and genuine government data.
how_it_works.pillar1_desc: Instead of forcing citizens to browse hundreds of irrelevant schemes, NammaSeve evaluates your age, district, education, and occupation to identify applicable opportunities.
how_it_works.pillar2_desc: Eligibility is never left to AI hallucination. We encode verifiable mathematical and logical rules from official gazettes into deterministic checks.
how_it_works.pillar3_desc: We never invent fake government records or demo schemes. Only genuine schemes verified from Seva Sindhu, myScheme, or official department portals are loaded.
how_it_works.outcome1_desc: Every documented official criterion in the scheme rules was matched by your citizen profile.
how_it_works.outcome2_desc: Key general criteria match, but external conditions require department verification.
how_it_works.outcome3_desc: The scheme requires specific criteria that you haven't answered yet in your profile.
how_it_works.outcome4_title: Not eligible based on documented criteria
how_it_works.outcome4_desc: One or more official exclusionary conditions apply.

about.title: About NammaSeve
about.subtitle: Bridging the gap between Indian government welfare policies and the everyday citizens who qualify for them.
about.p1: Millions of rupees in government welfare subsidies, youth stipends, farmer incentives, and healthcare schemes remain unclaimed each year because citizens either do not know about them or find eligibility guidelines overwhelming.
about.p2: NammaSeve solves this through an open, transparent, and profile-driven civic technology platform.
about.free_desc: Zero monetization, no paid consultations, and no paywalls for discovering welfare benefits.
about.no_aadhaar_desc: We never collect biometric data or sensitive identifiers. We calculate general eligibility and connect you to official government websites to apply directly.

footer.about_mission: Open civic platform matching Indian citizens with verified welfare benefits using deterministic criteria and official government records.
footer.civic_disclaimer_desc: NammaSeve does not collect application fees or disburse welfare funds. Responsible government departments make all binding eligibility and benefit determinations.
